description:
Replaces an exact string in a file with a new string. The old string must be unique in the file unless replace_all is true, so include enough surrounding context to identify the one occurrence you mean. Read the file first.

Usage:
- old_string is matched exactly, so whitespace, indentation, and line endings count. The line number and the pipe that Read shows are not part of the file.
- When old_string does not occur exactly once, the call fails and says how many times it occurs. With replace_all set to true, the call replaces every occurrence, and it fails only when there is none.
- Only UTF-8 text is edited. A file over {file_ceiling} bytes is refused.
- The calls in one response that change files run one after another, in the order you list them.

path.description: The absolute path of the file to modify

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)
